phase_history.notes: Spec from PDF 'Design af EQ-Plugin til Trance Leads, Plucks og Midbasses'. 3 work modes, key-tracking, spectrum analyzer, neuroinclusive Focus Mode UI.
6 RBJ biquad bands, mode templates (Lead/Pluck/Midbass), audio+MIDI key-track, dsp::FFT spectrum pushed to canvas. Midnight-blue/teal muted palette.
WebView UI: interactive spectrum + draggable EQ curve, mode tabs, Basic/Advanced Focus Mode.

framework_selection.rationale: Rich interactive spectrum analyzer + draggable EQ curve and a calm, customisable neuroinclusive UI are far easier with HTML5 Canvas than pure C++.
